reason: I sell with photos of finished homes and buyers have never once asked to see the house before we build. I'm in a truck between job sites all week, and I get pitched on this kind of thing constantly.
objection: No client has ever asked for it, so I'd be paying $1,500 a home for something that doesn't change whether I close the sale. And one business day for a walkthrough of a plan that's still being revised sounds like I'd be paying $500 a round for every change.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing that buyers actually sign sooner or pay for more upgrades when they get a walkthrough, ideally from another Utah builder my size.
